topic.name: Guide for the legal design of Digital Offers
topic.summary: Overview of mandatory legal requirements that must be observed when designing Bosch Digital Offers in the front end.

scope.definition_of_digital_offer: Any website, community, platform, mobile app, web shop, marketplace, etc., aimed at users.

related_app_guide.purpose: Legal requirements for development and distribution of apps via Apple and Google stores.

legal_context.eu_relevance: Most obligations are based on EU directives and therefore apply throughout the European Union.
legal_context.internationalization_requirement: A planned internationalization requires separate legal review; this guide is not a substitute for that review.

b2b.definition: Digital Offer exclusively addressed to commercial customers.

b2c.definition: Digital Offer addressed to consumers, meaning persons who want to use the Digital Offer mainly for private purposes.

mixed_b2b_b2c.definition: Digital Offer addressed to both commercial customers and consumers.
mixed_b2b_b2c.requirements: Observe both B2B and B2C requirements.

sub_service_providers.requirement: If a Digital Offer is provided on behalf of Bosch, sub-service providers must also comply with the mandatory information described in the guide.

finder_tool.name: Find your Lawyer Tool
finder_tool.description: Tool for finding the appropriate C/LS lawyer for questions about implementing legal design.

contacts.name: Nils Steffen
contacts.role: Contact for the data protection section of the guide

feature_requests_and_bugs.scope: Digital Design System or Frontend Kit

design_feedback.usage: Questions about designing digital touchpoints and review of design drafts.

recommended_use: Use as a compliance-oriented reference structure for Digital Offer design workflows.
Route legal questions to C/LS and data protection questions to C/ISP.
Treat the content as guidance, not legal advice.
Apply B2B, B2C, or mixed-offer logic before deriving requirements.
risk_flags: German-law basis may not be sufficient for international offers.
Sub-service providers must be checked when acting on behalf of Bosch.
